# Completion Report: Work Order 6 — MCP Pull Tools (`pr-08-v2-delivery-wo6`)

## Objective & Implementation Summary

Implemented the 5 MCP server pull tools in [`internal/mcpserver/tools.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go) and server dispatch in [`internal/mcpserver/server.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go), replacing the legacy stub handler:

1. **`memory.brief`** ([`HandleMemoryBrief`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L78-L130)):
   - Accepts [`MemoryBriefRequest`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L16-L18) `{ "scope": "string" }`.
   - Resolves aliases via [`Index.ResolveAlias`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/aliases.go) if scope is not found directly.
   - Lists entries by scope and filters out retired/superseded entries.
   - Truncates entry text over 200 runes.
   - Records exposure of pulled entries in [`delivery.Ledger.RecordPull`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go).
   - Formats header `Scope: <scope> (<count> entries)` and line items `[<type>] <id>: <text>`.

2. **`memory.why`** ([`HandleMemoryWhy`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L132-L217)):
   - Accepts [`MemoryWhyRequest`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L26-L28) `{ "entryId": "string" }`.
   - Fetches entry via [`Index.GetEntry`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L99) (with graceful fallback to [`Index.GetHistory`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L418) for retired-only entries).
   - Formats entry type, scope, text, anchors, evidence/provenance, verification status, timestamps, and history details.
   - Records pull exposure via [`delivery.Ledger.RecordPull`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go).

3. **`memory.history`** ([`HandleMemoryHistory`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L219-L259)):
   - Accepts [`MemoryHistoryRequest`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L36-L38) `{ "scope": "string" }`.
   - Retrieves retired/superseded entries via [`Index.QueryHistoryByScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L452) and entries marked retired, supporting alias resolution.
   - Formats entry ID, type, text, retired reason, and `superseded by` target.
   - Records pull exposure via [`delivery.Ledger.RecordPull`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go).

4. **`memory.search`** ([`HandleMemorySearch`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L315-L352)):
   - Accepts [`MemorySearchRequest`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L46-L48) `{ "query": "string" }`.
   - Queries FTS5 BM25 index via [`Index.SearchEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go).
   - Limits results to top 10 and truncates snippets to 100 runes.
   - Records pull exposure in the ledger for each returned entry.

5. **`memory.note`** ([`HandleMemoryNote`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L354-L421)):
   - Accepts [`MemoryNoteRequest`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L56-L60) `{ "scope": "string", "text": "string", "type": "string" }`. Defaults type to `"decision"`.
   - Validates scope, text, and that type is a valid [`dossiers.EntryType`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/dossiers/entry.go#L7).
   - Generates typed entry ID and writes an [`ops.OpAdd`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/op.go) batch to the ops directory via [`ops.Writer`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/writer.go) with `source: "agent"`.
   - Synchronizes entry to the index for immediate visibility.
   - Returns response `Note recorded: <entryID>`.

6. **Server Registration & Dispatch**:
   - Registered tools in [`ToolSchemas()`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L121) and [`DispatchTool()`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L185) supporting both canonical underscore names and dotted aliases.
   - Deprecated [`HandleMemoryAsk`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L84).

7. **Comprehensive Testing**:
   - [`internal/mcpserver/tools_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools_test.go) and [`internal/mcpserver/server_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server_test.go) cover:
     - `memory.brief` active entry formatting, text truncation, retired entry filtering, and alias resolution.
     - `memory.why` complete provenance, history entries, ledger recording, and historical entry resolution.
     - `memory.search` ranked BM25 queries, top 10 limiting, and empty/no-match cases.
     - `memory.history` retired/superseded filtering, alias resolution, and empty scope responses.
     - `memory.note` op log writing, index upsert, decision type defaulting, and input validation.
     - Schema listing and dispatch routing (including nil index handling and parameter unmarshaling).
